predictors.RIDAGEYR: Age at screening; 80 means 80 or older.
predictors.RIAGENDR: Released variable labelled Gender; 1=Male, 2=Female. Preserve source definition.
predictors.INDFMPIR: Derived family-income-to-poverty ratio; topcoded at 5; preserve missingness.

availability.evidence: Demographic questionnaires administered at home; DPQ administered at MEC.
availability.limitation: INDFMPIR is a processed derived value. Retrospective screening assumes its inputs and calculation are available before DPQ; real-time availability is not established.

component_weight.basis: DPQ_J analytic notes explicitly specify the two-year MEC examination weight.
limitations: Does not resolve selection bias from incomplete DPQ outcomes.
